title: Bus Studio
summary: I2C/SPI/UART/Logic, ESP32-S3 Companion Lab, Power Scope & 6-Model INT8 ML
description: Bus Studio is a non-root hardware bus, logic analyzer, power profiler & ESP32-S3 Companion Lab for CardputerZero: 16x8 I2C Bus Radar (140+ WHO_AM_I chips) & live register plotter, Read-Only SPI NOR Flash JEDEC 0x9F + entropy scanner, Auto-Baud Smart UART Console, 4-CH kernel-timestamped Logic Analyzer with IEEE .vcd export, bq27220 Battery & 5-CH m5ioe1 ADC Oscillograph, 4-CH Hardware PWM & Safe Rails, interactive CardputerZero visual wire maps (press W), Pure-Go ESP32-S3 SLIP ROM / eFuse / NVS / CrashDoctor / HeapTracker lab, 6 embedded INT8 neural models (33.3 KiB, 0 allocs), and opt-in 38-tool MCP.
